correctness.rationale: For exactly five line agents, sort gaps a,b,c,d>=0. Two unconstrained facilities have OPT2=min(b+2c+d,a+c+d,a+b+d,a+2b+c). Distance-proportional pair sampling has normalizer Z=4a+6b+6c+4d and weighted expected-cost numerator N. The two polynomial envelopes U1,U2 of N are obtained by choosing one endpoint service distance for each pair-client term; both dominate min. Expanded coefficients of 9 Z T1-4 U1 and 9 Z T2-4 U2 are ALL nonnegative, and reflection handles T3,T4. Thus E[SC]<=9 OPT2/4 for all real gaps, including coincidences and zero-opt cases. Independent SymPy slack coefficient re-expansion and exact enumeration of many integer gap quadruples confirmed, not substituted for polynomial proof. Gaps (T,1,0,1) give ratio (18T+22)/(8T+20)->9/4, strictly not attained for finite positive-optimum profiles.
